title: Remarkable utilization of quinazoline-based homosulfonamide for in vitro cytotoxic effects with triple kinase inhibition activities: cell cycle analysis and molecular docking profile
content:

Adel S. El-Azab, Alaa A.-M. Abdel-Aziz, Ahmed H. Bakheit, Hamad M. Alkahtani, Ahmad J. Obaidullah, Mohamed M. Hefnawy, Ibrahim A. Al-Suwaidan
Hydrazone 5 had a higher mean GI50 (1.1 μM) than gefitinib and erlotinib (2.1 and 7.7 μM). Compared to gefitinib and dinaciclib, hydrazones 5 and 6 strongly inhibit EGFR, HER2, and CDK9 kinases. They are also less toxic to WI-38 than doxorubicin.
